subject: xAI public all hands, inside Siri revamp, AI changing everything
body:
Hi David,

Big Tech & Startups

Musk Restructures xAI's Teams After Co-Founders Depart (4 minute read)

Elon Musk has restructured xAI following the exit of two of its co-founders earlier this week. xAI will now be organized into four core areas: Grok's chatbot and voice product, Coding, the Imagine video product, and Macrohard. The company plans to launch a new X Chat app and X Money in the coming months. It is currently looking to hire.

Apple's Latest Attempt to Launch New Siri Runs Into Snags (9 minute read)

Several highly anticipated Siri functions may be pushed back as testing has run into snags in recent weeks. Apple now plans to spread out new capabilities over several versions, so some features will be postponed until iOS 26.5 or iOS 27. One feature especially likely to slip is the expanded ability for Siri to tap into personal data. Another feature running behind schedule is voice-based control of in-app actions. While early support for these features exists, they don't function reliably in all cases.

- Dan

subject: We got your inquiry
body:
David,
 
If performance isn't the thing there are plenty of conferences out there. I can give you some pointers on how to locate them. You can choose something close to home or in a different region. Topics run the gamut.

As for graphs, actually a very good friend of mine from Apple Labs was a leader in something called Conceptual Graphs. My recollection of this field is it focuses on the modeling of information in graphs (edges and nodes) so that it can be applied to AI systems.  This was developed in the 70s and 80s originally by a guy named Sowa. Perhaps you want to look into it. 

My friend led the annual conference in this area till his passing a few years back. You can search on his name - William Tepfenhart. I also notice that there are current references in this field including 2025 related to applying CGs to AI and LLMs etc.

Let me know if you want to talk with William.

All the best,
